run_accelerate_cli: run the accelerate CLI tool with subcommands for distributed training configuration
create_config_accelerate: create an accelerate configuration file for distributed training setup
run_estimate_memory: run the estimate command to check memory usage for a HuggingFace model across different dtypes
run_env_check: run the env command to print system and accelerate environment information
run_launch_train: run the launch command to start a distributed training job with GPU, TPU, or DeepSpeed
run_merge_weights: run the merge-weights command to merge FSDP sharded checkpoints into a single checkpoint
run_test_setup: run the test command to verify accelerate installation and distributed training readiness
run_tpu_config: run the tpu-config command to execute setup commands across TPU VMs
run_to_fsdp2_convert: run the to-fsdp2 command to convert an accelerate config from FSDP1 to FSDP2
